about: A starting voicing for a two-staff piano reduction (part 1, after a vocal part 0). Held chords and inner lines a little back; the repeated-chord pulse further back; fast figuration (sextuplets, tremolos) as a soft blanket; the bass slightly back; the top moving line of the right hand brought out and slightly ahead. Then read the full score and add bar-range voices where the reduction moves lines between hands or voices (later voices win), and check with scripts/voice-balance.ts.

voices.name: Melody (top moving line of the right hand)
